performance_issues.description: The initial db.Find has no pagination (ListOptions is zero-value). All matching notifications are loaded into memory.
performance_issues.impact: A user with thousands of unread notifications will load all of them, causing memory pressure and very long response times
performance_issues.recommendation: Add a reasonable limit or use pagination. Consider processing in batches.
